title: Avoid multiplying ordinary Hamiltonian action by sampled activity
statement: For D=16G(L+1)+p+log(100/epsilon)+2,choose tau=1/D with safe certified dyadic replacement. Deterministic S=O(G(L+1)+p+log1/epsilon+1),S tau=O(1),and per-call candidate mean<=1/[32(L+1)]remove hidden activity-sized source loops. Each actual binary-duration circuit is bounded by Ttau,so controlled qubitization sums actual free-action cost rather than charging only a selected path. QH=O(A(Kcap+1)alpha_f T+S A(Kcap+1)B[1+log(B/delta_slot)]);QF=O(S A(Kcap+1)). Encoding query cost and gate implementation cost remain separate. L=O(1+mu+log(2+Tg)+log1/epsilon)becomes polylog only for bounded mu;unbounded mu retains real polynomialLcost.
